CC: thick painful nails plus new heel pain on ambulation

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Exam: nails examined consistent with thickened painful nails. Separately identified: tenderness at a distinct anatomic location with documented quality, palpable swelling, and pain on resisted motion.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
